title: Bind Tau TUI voice events to Chatterbox /tau/voice-render and real turn controls
disposition: PROGRESS — core real integration proven live; full 8-scenario suite not complete (not closing to avoid a premature reopen).
correction: Earlier this session I called #223 'blocked on the Chatterbox service' after probing the wrong ports (:8000 is the Unsloth UI backend). VERIFIED: the Chatterbox agent server is running on :8018 (process 1557383, uvicorn chatterbox.agent.server:app), /health ok live model_loaded cuda, and it already implements /tau/voice-render + /turn/{id}/cancel + /playback/{id}/duck|stop (server.py:2128,2301,2306). No chatterbox ticket is warranted.

proven_live_on_8018.tau_voice_render: announce_state_change posts a tau.voice_render_request.v1 envelope to /tau/voice-render; returned service_ok=true, live=true, mocked=false, failed_gates=[] (real chatterbox_turbo synthesis).
proven_live_on_8018.turn_controls: cancel_turn -> /turn/{id}/cancel, duck_playback -> /playback/{id}/duck, stop_playback -> /playback/{id}/stop all returned ok=true live.
proven_live_on_8018.refuse_approval: interpret_spoken_command('yes approve it') -> approval_rejected, side_effect_authorized=false (voice is not approval authority).
proven_live_on_8018.sha256_contract: raw hex digests match the chatterbox question_text/chunk sha256_matches gates.

deterministic_tests: tests/test_tui_voice.py: 6 passed (versioned envelope + lineage + raw-hex sha256, turn controls to real endpoints, degraded path, refuse-approval).

acceptance_map.contract_and_failure_tests: MET: schema/hashes/lineage deterministic; missing config -> one degraded receipt; refuse approve/authorized/yes.
acceptance_map.live_item_4_cancel_stop_by_turn_id: PARTIAL: cancel/stop live-OK; 'no later PCM accepted for the turn' not yet asserted.
remaining: live item 1/3: delivery-policy affect mapping (run-state -> tone/intensity/valence) proving chatterbox_turbo for no-affect and chatterbox_base for a weighted request with recorded emotion knobs;
live item 5: supersede an old announcement; stale turn cannot resume;
live item 6: play audio through the documented local path and retain the result;
live items 7/8: stop Chatterbox -> Tau degrades; restart -> a later new turn succeeds.

proves: Tau projects authoritative run/turn state into the real Chatterbox /tau/voice-render contract with live, non-mocked synthesis, real turn controls, and a preserved non-authority/refuse-approval boundary — the real-service integration #158 explicitly did not prove.
does_not_prove: The full 8-scenario live suite (affect base-model selection, stale-turn supersession, audio playback retention, stop/restart resilience) — enumerated above as remaining.
